description: Four storeys of weathered board on Main Street, the tallest thing in the Reach that isn't a mast. A covered gallery runs across the front over the porch, every window has a different curtain, and there's a dish or an aerial on every ledge. Up on the false front a coyote howls in amber neon, the brightest light for fifty miles. The batwing doors are always open.
name: The Coyote's Rest
